mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% per annum compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
